author: Ava Mitchell
title: A Job Fair and Recovery Pop-Up for L.A. Wildfire Survivors is Coming to Pasadena - NewsBreak
text:
Courtesy of GEM / Shutterstock For the first time ever, the Hire a Survivor job fair will be held in Pasadena on July 19 from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. Partners Global Empowerment Mission (GEM), Cal OES and the Los Angeles Economic Development Corporation (LAEDC) organized the fair to aid survivors in finding employment after the destruction caused by the January wildfires. “Hire a survivor, because it’s more than just a job," said Michael Capponi, founder of GEM. "It’s a direct investment in healing and rebuilding our communities. Steady employment creates the foundation for long-term housing stability and personal recovery. This initiative shines a light on fire survivors and calls on all of us to take part in their journey forward.”
GEM has been an integral force of aid in the Los Angeles fire crisis. Within 72 hours of the fires starting, the organization's large warehouse hub was set up and working to aid all areas affected by the fires. GEM has hosted multiple recovery pop-ups, which provided mental health services, medical support, aid distribution and childcare services. GEM has also distributed $535,000 in direct cash assistance, $8 million in In-Kind credits, $500,000 in rental and small business recovery funding and over 16,000 necessity kits and emergency relief packages. Now, they are in a new phase of aid: helping the community get back on its feet after the devastation. Courtesy of GEM / Shutterstock Courtesy of GEM / Shutterstock Hire a Survivor will bring in employers conducting on-the-spot hiring, including the LA County Department of Economic Opportunity’s Fire Recovery and Resilience Workforce Program. But more than just a job fair, the Saturday afternoon will be a resource hub and space for some fun. Attendees will also have access to resume help, job coaching, free food, giveaways, signing up for L.A. County's Youth@Work Program, and a kids zone for families.
“Eaton Fire survivors deserve every bit of support to help get them back on their feet,” said Los Angeles Board of Supervisors Chair Kathryn Barger. “I am proud to support this job fair which brings together state, county, and non-profit partners locally. I wholeheartedly support providing a comprehensive approach to helping fire survivors in their job search. Finding and securing work is a key step in their recovery journey.”
Hire a Survivor will be held at PazNaz Church on 3700 E. Sierra Madre Blvd. in Pasadena.
